prompt: If the orchestra had posted the new entrance on its ticket page, we _____ at the locked gate before the concert.
promptZh: 如果樂團當時把新入口公告在票券頁面，我們就不會在音樂會前在上鎖的大門那裡等了。

options.whyZh: will not wait 表未來，不符合句中演出前已發生的情況。
did not wait 直述過去事實，未表達相反假設的結果。
had posted 引出過去反事實，主句用 would not have waited 表本可避免的等待。
do not wait 是一般現在式，不描述那次演出前的假設結果。

explanationZh: had posted 引出過去反事實，主句用 would not have waited 表本可避免的等待。
evidence: If the orchestra had posted the new entrance on its ticket page, we would not have waited at the locked gate before the concert.

vocabulary.note: 本題句中的實用用法；請對照完整例句。
